process previsit.outreach v1
Subject: case
Stages: [previsit]
Start: cycle
Uses: [rule/previsit.missing_items]
Requires: [outreach@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=missing, Type=Integer, IsInput=false}]
Scenarios: [nothing missing, reply after the first reminder, two reminders then escalate, unknown delivery goes to a task, transient failure is retried]
step cycle
  Kind: Loop
  Stage: previsit
  Routes: [{Label=body, Target=check}, {Label=onExhausted, Target=escalate_final}]
  Loop: {MaxIterations=2}
step check
  Kind: Read
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=assess}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}]
  Port: intake.status
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=1, Backoff=none, Initial=00:00:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  Outputs: [{Name=missing_count, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
  OutputNames: [missing]
step assess
  Kind: Decide
  Routes: [{Label=on:none, Target=done}, {Label=on:remind, Target=send}, {Label=onNoDecision, Target=escalate}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}]
  Rule: previsit.missing_items
  RouteField: action
  Facts: [{Name=missing, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [missing]
step send
  Kind: Action
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=reply}, {Label=onError, Target=escalate}, {Label=onUnknown, Target=escalate}]
  Port: messaging.notice
  Delivery: AtMostOnce
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=3, Backoff=exponential, Initial=00:01:00, Max=00:10:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}, {Name=missing, Variable=missing}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step reply
  Kind: Wait
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=cycle}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=cycle}]
  Event: form_submitted
  Correlation: case_ref
  Timeout: {Duration=1.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref]
step escalate
  Kind: HumanTask
  Routes: [{Label=on:resolved, Target=cycle}, {Label=on:unreachable, Target=closed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=closed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [resolved, unreachable]
  Show: [case_ref, missing]
  Timeout: {Duration=3.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step escalate_final
  Kind: HumanTask
  Routes: [{Label=on:resolved, Target=done}, {Label=on:unreachable, Target=closed}, {Label=onTimeout, Target=closed}]
  Queue: front_desk
  Outcomes: [resolved, unreachable]
  Show: [case_ref, missing]
  Timeout: {Duration=3.00:00:00}
  InputNames: [case_ref, missing]
step done
  Kind: End
  Result: ready
step closed
  Kind: End
  Result: unreachable
